label: Birthday
lines: This one goes out to [name]. Happy birthday! Have a proper one, and turn it up.
Big birthday love to [name]. Another year older, still on the dancefloor.
Happy birthday, [name]! Hands in the air, this one's all yours.

label: Wedding
lines: This one goes out to [name] and [name]. Congratulations on the big day!
To the newlyweds, [name] and [name]. Love is in the air, and so is this tune.
[name] and [name], you did it! Massive congratulations. Let's get this party started.

label: Anniversary
lines: Happy anniversary to [name] and [name]. Still going strong, nonstop, back to back.
This one's for [name] and [name], celebrating another year together. Lovely stuff.
To [name] and [name]: happy anniversary, and here's to many more.

label: Stag do
lines: This one goes out to [name] and the crew. Last night of freedom, so make it count!
Big shout to [name] on the stag. Behave yourselves. Or don't. Turn it up!
[name]'s stag do is officially open. We are going in!

label: Hen do
lines: This one goes out to [name] and the crew. Hen do mode: activated!
Big love to [name] on the hen do. Dance like nobody's watching.
[name]'s hen do starts right now. Hands up, glasses up!

label: Work do
lines: This one goes out to the [team] crew. Laptops closed, dancefloor open!
To everyone at [team]: you've earned this one. Turn it up.
Big shout to [team]. Work's done, now it's time to dance.

label: Leaving do
lines: This one goes out to [name]. Sad to see you go, but what a send-off! Good luck.
Farewell, [name]! New adventures await, and this one's for you.
[name], it won't be the same without you. Go on, one last dance.

label: Just because
lines: This one goes out to [name], just because. Love it.
For [name], who still owes me a tenner. You know who you are!
No reason, no occasion. This one's just for you, [name].
